session: Forge repo-backed image packs: implementation, two independent review rounds, integration and 0.5.0 release
state_line: FORGE 0.5.0 RELEASED WITH REPO-BACKED IMAGE PACKS. main@4d88ad03ecc8e59f84d0760c8c34db461c5b466f carries the reviewed and approved implementation (dcaa1465) plus the automatic loader pin; a manifest may now bind each @img to an immutable repository blob (path + 40-hex commit + SHA-256), Forge fetches and verifies those bytes when the manifest is opened, and Start is refused unless every bound image is the exact verified file. Canonical Forge CI and release-pin are green on dcaa1465. The push/53 Godstorm repair is NOT yet packable: its eight processed .webp files are not in the repository and cannot be authored from anything that is. No live TNR request or write was made in this session.

decisions: 2026-09-19 APPROVED: Forge manifests may bind @img references to immutable repository blobs; ref must be a 40-hex commit, never a branch or tag.
2026-09-19 APPROVED: a pack-bound image has no manual picker override; the manual picker remains only for images no pack binds.
2026-09-19 APPROVED: integrate dcaa1465 to main and let release_pin.yml promote Forge to 0.5.0 (user authorised the merge and the release in session).
2026-09-19 RULED (user): the eight processed Godstorm .webp files will be supplied by dauntless for commit; they are not to be re-derived from the committed lime-key originals.
2026-09-19 ACCEPTED (reviewer): the pre-upload re-hash is kept although identity alone would close F1; a separate Forge size pass should be planned before further substantial Forge features.
deployed: Forge 0.5.0 released: loader @version 0.5.0, @require pinned to forge_bundle.js at dcaa1465 via jsDelivr, @x-release-pending removed by release_pin.yml.

Repo-backed image packs live in the shipped bundle: runner/imgpack.mjs (contract), storage/assets.mjs (digest-keyed asset cache + content-keyed upload ledger), core/imagepack.mjs (prepare/commit/gate).
forge/tools/make_image_pack.mjs authors a pack by reading blobs with git cat-file at a resolved commit, so an uncommitted file cannot be bound.
Two independent review rounds closed: F1 (Start did not bind the verified File) and F2 (stale preparation could write into a newer selection), both corrected and re-reviewed CLOSED.
Forge bundle budget stepped twice within this feature to 470,000 raw / 92,000 gzip; the bundle is at ~96% of both.

dauntless: Update/reinstall the Forge loader and confirm the panel title shows 0.5.0 before trusting any smoke result; refreshing required resources alone does not update the loader.
Supply the eight approved processed Godstorm .webp files so the push/53 image pack can be generated.
After the pack is generated and validated, open push/53 in Forge and confirm all eight repo-backed images read verified before tapping Start.
Run the Godstorm repair. The play tap is the only act that touches the game; no agent performs it.
Optionally delete redundant branch refs per docs/reviews/FORGE_NEXT_BRANCH_CLEANUP_FINAL.md.
claude: On receipt of the eight .webp files: commit them to a durable art path, run make_image_pack.mjs --write against that commit, re-run validate.py from the skill data/ directory, and report the pack with its per-file digests.
Do not re-derive the eight files from the committed lime-key originals and do not rewrite imgSizes to match a re-processing.
Plan the Forge size pass before the next substantial Forge feature.
